items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Kazooka. That kazooka, he was made there.

ctx.x: But he would play that funny little banjo, that homemade banjo on a real band? Yeah, on a real band.

He made it. It was made. I didn't know if I could get my hand on it. I'm going to find out from some of these people that they got that banjo. It's made out of cheese box. He glued that and made it and put heads on it. It was a banjo too. I'd love to see it. You could hear that baby, you could hear that baby. Yeah, he made it. Now just like Noone had made that horn, he used to slide. Kazooka. That kazooka, he was made there.
Did you go uptown to hear many bands in downtown?
